name: Inplain
description: Turns a sentence or an agent's output into a finished presentation, document or dashboard as a self-contained web page, on your own API key or locally with Ollama.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Anthropic API key. Generate and edit tools need one documented backend: this key, another provider key, OLLAMA_BASE_URL, or `plain login`.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: OpenAI API key. Alternative LLM backend to ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

GOOGLE_GENERATIVE_AI_API_KEY.description: Google Generative AI API key. Alternative LLM backend to ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

MOONSHOT_API_KEY.description: Moonshot API key. Alternative LLM backend to ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.description: DeepSeek API key. Alternative LLM backend to ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

OLLAMA_BASE_URL.description: Ollama base URL for fully local generation, for example http://localhost:11434.
